decisions.reason: The keyword research report already has a same-message MODIFY that adds "knitted animals" to its specified replacement keywords, so no additional or corrected Event is needed.
The source changes a keyword selection, not the selection of blog topics.
Changing a selected blog keyword does not alter the required article type, trial inclusion, or article count.
The keyword replacement does not change the SEO plan's deliverable, included service areas, or content limitations.
